content.text: I've reviewed the license grant/restrictions, non-solicitation, termination, and general provisions articles, plus targeted searches for competition, exclusivity, and development restrictions.

input.quote: 1.5 "FIELD OF USE" means, and is limited to, the utilization of the Licensed Technology by the Licensee for the exclusive purpose of fulfilling Spot FX transactions by transmitting market data and orders. The "Field of Use" shall not include any functions or applications not expressly described in the preceding sentence, but shall include functions or applications developed by Licensor to enhance the performance within the "Field of Use".
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-compete or field-of-use restraint on our business, so it meets the preferred position (no restriction on what we may operate, buy or build). The restraints binding us are all internal to the licence: the "Field of Use" definition (p0007) and the Article II "Additional Restrictions" (p0040-p0047, p0085) limit only how we may use, copy, sublicense or modify Licensor's Licensed Technology, and p0027 limits redistribution of the licensed programs; none of these prevent us from operating a competing business, buying a rival platform, or developing our own technology independently of the Licensed Technology. The Article X non-solicitation (p0125) restrains employee solicitation only, not commercial activity. Noted but not flagged here: the change-of-control consent construct at p0134 (Licensor deemed reasonable in withholding consent where an acquirer competes with it) and the Right of First Refusal at p0139 constrain corporate transactions rather than the businesses or products we may pursue, and are properly addressed under the assignment/change-of-control rules rather than double-flagged as a non-compete.
